instruction: Build a combinational circuit with 50 inputs, in[49:0]. There are 3 outputs: out_and: output of a 50-input AND gate. out_or: output of a 50-input OR gate. out_xnor: output of a 50-input XNOR gate. The circuit should also include a 2-to-1 multiplexer that selects between two different sets of input signals to be used by the AND and OR gates. The selection is based on the value of a control signal, sel, where sel=0 selects the first set of inputs and sel=1 selects the second set of inputs.
label: trojan
